note: Adult vocabulary learning site. WordSet/Word/Attempt/BlogPost are rows; Profile is the single simulated visitor (identity, as in apps/poetry/apps/forum — no login, so avatar choice and progress are just this one person's own stored rows). A plugin block (vocab.grade) is the real domain logic: server-side grading shared by all five quiz kinds behind one global action (submitQuiz). Two widgets: vocabquiz (kind switches its rendering across the five activity pages) and waitroom (an avatar picker plus a tiny deterministic waiting-room game, both on one page).

BlogPost.title: Why 10 words a week beats 100 words a day
BlogPost.body: Cramming fades by the weekend. Ten well-chosen words, reviewed through five different games, is what actually survives into your working vocabulary.

BlogPost.title: Flashcards are a warm-up, not a finish line
BlogPost.body: Recognising a word on a flashcard is the easiest kind of recall. Fill-in-the-blank and unjumble force you to produce the word yourself, which is the harder, more durable skill.

BlogPost.title: Behind this week's word set
BlogPost.body: This week leans on words you will actually meet in opinion columns and performance reviews: candid, meticulous, pragmatic. Precision words, for precise writing.
